question: Why does the group of moving creatures search everywhere for the unobstructed lord?
premises: The group of moving and vocal creatures searches here and there.
It seeks the one whose movement is unobstructed.
The search is for the sake of satisfaction.
inference: All moving beings seek the freely moving lord in order to attain fulfillment.
uncertainties: vāścāravargo is an unusual compound; sense inferred from members.
plain_english: The group of creatures that move and call also searches here and there for you, whose movement is unobstructed, in order to find satisfaction.
